entry.title: A Study of Low-Resource Neural Machine Translation
entry.summary: We study neural machine translation for low-resource language pairs and show that subword tokenization improves BLEU scores. A limitation of our approach is that it was only evaluated on one language pair.

entry.title: Mutation Testing for Cyber-Physical Systems: A Survey
entry.summary: This survey reviews mutation testing techniques applied to cyber-physical systems and identifies open challenges in scaling these techniques to industrial systems.
